description: Structural superposition figure and provenance tables for the ACCSL catalytic arginine loss
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, os

# ---- values computed in the preceding superposition run (1YNU chain A frame) ----
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5.0))

ax = axes[0]
labels = ['ACCS R457\n(guanidinium)', 'ACCSL nearest Arg\n(R403, PLP-phosphate Arg)',
          'ACCSL C529\n(SG, the Arg replacement)']
vals   = [3.81, 10.31, 7.39]
cols   = ['#1A6B4A', '#B4232A', '#B4232A']
b = ax.barh(labels[::-1], vals[::-1], color=cols[::-1], height=0.55)
for r, v in zip(b, vals[::-1]):
    ax.text(v+0.25, r.get_y()+r.get_height()/2, f'{v:.2f} A', va='center', fontsize=11)
ax.axvline(4.0, ls='--', color='#444444', lw=1.2)
ax.text(4.15, 2.45, 'hydrogen-bond /\nsalt-bridge range', fontsize=9, color='#444444')
ax.set_xlabel('Distance to the substrate alpha-carboxylate of the PLP-vinylglycine adduct (A)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(0, 13)
ax.set_title('A  AlphaFold models superposed on apple ACS (1YNU)\ncore CA RMSD 1.41 A (ACCS), 1.42 A (ACCSL)',
             loc='left', fontsize=11.5, weight='bold')
for s in ('top','right'): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax = axes[1]
items = [('ACCS R457 guanidinium', 0.86, '#1A6B4A'),
         ('ACCSL Y520 OH ring', 2.41, '#B4232A'),
         ('ACCSL C529 SG', 3.85, '#B4232A'),
         ('ACCSL nearest Arg (R403)', 10.31, '#B4232A')]
for i,(lab,v,c) in enumerate(items[::-1]):
    ax.barh(i, v, color=c, height=0.55)
    ax.text(v+0.25, i, f'{v:.2f} A', va='center', fontsize=11)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(items))); ax.set_yticklabels([i[0] for i in items[::-1]], fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel('Distance to the MdACS Arg407 guanidinium position (A)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(0, 13)
ax.set_title('B  Occupancy of the catalytic arginine site\nACCS reproduces it; ACCSL fills it with Tyr520 and Cys529',
             loc='left', fontsize=11.5, weight='bold')
for s in ('top','right'): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle('No arginine occupies the substrate alpha-carboxylate site in the human ACCSL model',
             fontsize=13, weight='bold', y=1.0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ---- provenance tables ----
outdir = os.getcwd()
t1 = pd.DataFrame([
 ('K273','PLP Schiff base (covalent, 1.48 A)','K323','conserved','K395','conserved'),
 ('R407','substrate alpha-carboxylate (2.71 A)','R457','conserved','C529','LOST'),
 ("R281","PLP 5'-phosphate (2.69 A)",'R331','conserved','R403','conserved'),
 ('D230','PLP pyridine N1 salt bridge','D286','conserved','D358','conserved'),
 ('Y233','PLP re-face stacking','Y289','conserved','Y361','conserved'),
 ('Y145','substrate pocket','Y195','conserved','Y267','conserved'),
 ('Y19','active site / PLP phosphate','Y62','conserved','S149','LOST'),
 ('N202','PLP pyridine region','N258','conserved','N330','conserved'),
 ('A120','ACS phosphate loop','G170','substituted','C242','substituted'),
 ('T121','ACS phosphate loop','A171','substituted','C243','substituted'),
], columns=['MdACS_residue','role_in_1YNU','human_ACCS','ACCS_status','human_ACCSL','ACCSL_status'])
t1.to_csv(os.path.join(outdir,'ACCSL_active_site_conservation.csv'), index=False)

t2 = pd.DataFrame([
 ('ACCS','R457 guanidinium',0.86,3.81,'occupies the catalytic Arg site'),
 ('ACCSL','Y520 ring',2.41,5.06,'fills the Arg site with an aromatic side chain'),
 ('ACCSL','C529 SG',3.85,7.39,'the residue aligned to MdACS R407'),
 ('ACCSL','R403 (nearest Arg)',None,10.31,'binds the PLP 5-phosphate, not the substrate'),
], columns=['protein','atom_group','dist_to_MdACS_R407_guanidinium_A','dist_to_substrate_alpha_carboxylate_A','note'])
t2.to_csv(os.path.join(outdir,'ACCSL_structural_superposition.csv'), index=False)
print('wrote tables to', outdir)
print(t1.to_string(index=False)); print(); print(t2.to_string(index=False))
